explanation: King David is a central figure in 1 Chronicles 11, who was Israel's second king and the founder of the united kingdom of Israel and Judah.
The capital city of ancient Israel and Judah, also known as Zion. In 1 Chronicles 11, the city is conquered by David and his men and becomes David's capital.
A military leader who commands an army. In 1 Chronicles 11, several commanders are mentioned who served under King David and fought alongside him.
This term refers to the outstanding warriors and leaders who supported and fought together with David. They played a vital role in King David's victories and success.
An ancient people who lived in Canaan, on the southwest coast of present-day Israel. The Philistines were often in conflict with the Israelites, and their battles are described in 1 Chronicles 11.
One of David's closest allies and nephew. He was commander for King David and played an important role in the conquest of Jerusalem.
